stem: 在姓名筛查的背景下，模糊逻辑或模糊匹配是一种方法，其：

options.A: 利用机器学习根据历史数据预测名称
options.B: 将筛查名单上的姓名与拼写、模式或发音相似的姓名进行匹配
options.C: 将长度相同且字符相同的名称进行匹配
options.D: 仅依赖于精确的字符串匹配

stem_en: In the context of name screening, fuzzy logic or fuzzy matching is a method that:

options_en.A: Uses machine learning to predict names based on historical data
options_en.B: Matches names on screening lists to names with similar spellings, patterns, or sounds
options_en.C: Matches names with the same length and characters
options_en.D: Relies exclusively on exact string matches
